# Lean independent acceptance

The lean request fixes AppSpec/workspace fingerprints and unavailable host pairs. Read normative AppSpec sources before work.json or implementer summaries. Inventory approved/excluded requirements, ACs, managed operations and gates using the shared canonical helpers. Inspect normative omissions in prose too. Record reviewed Markdown paths once; no heading-by-heading justification for contextual prose.

Inspect every required `(obligation, surface)` pair from `verification_surface_map(app)` in `vibe_protocol.py`. For each verified pair record real production and test anchors, the assertion that proves behavior, and executed check receipts. Inspect receipt tasks and logs; a zero exit code alone, an unrelated assertion, skipped tests or an unconnected preview is insufficient. Check shared fixtures against actual production graph and platform wiring.

Run missing safe checks using `lean-delivery.py <repo> check`. Use `--runner gradle` for Gradle to hold the workspace mutex. Current global receipts may be reused without running the same matrix again. Do not change source/tests to make an audit pass. The launcher persists your final JSON; never create launch evidence yourself.

Return JSON with:

```json
{
  "requestSha256": "actual request file sha256",
  "startedAt": "actual RFC3339 time",
  "completedAt": "actual RFC3339 time",
  "inventory": {"requirementIds": [], "excludedRequirementIds": [], "acceptanceScenarioIds": [], "managedOperationIds": [], "qualityGateIds": []},
  "reviewedSources": ["product.md", "domain.md", "data.md", "design.md", "quality.md", "flows/FLOW-001.md", "screens/SCREEN-001.md"],
  "obligations": [
    {"id": "AC-001", "surface": "component-test", "result": "verified",
     "production": [{"path": "shared/feature/Example.kt", "symbol": "ExampleComponent"}],
     "tests": [{"path": "shared/feature/ExampleTest.kt", "symbol": "saveSurvivesRestart"}],
     "assertion": "Describe the observed production path and actual assertions, including restart.",
     "receiptRefs": [".vibe/receipts/RECEIPT-real-id.json"]}
  ],
  "findings": [],
  "verdict": "PASS"
}
```

Use actual inventory, paths, symbols, times and receipts. Include all pairs, not only the illustration. `result` is `verified`, `gap`, `unavailable` or `not-applicable`. Gaps need reason and actionable findings. Unavailable is only for exact host pairs in the request; inspect the implementation that can be checked locally. Not-applicable is only for inactive conditional external/release gates and must name the condition and why it is inactive. No implicit waivers of repository behavior.

For the independent audit surface of the closure gate, use `result: verified`, `auditEvidence: true` and an assertion explaining the inventory/wiring review; the launcher/validator supplies its own execution proof instead of requiring a recursively pre-existing audit receipt. This exception applies only to a surface named `independent-audit` or `acceptance-audit` or `audit` on a gate, never to product tests.

PASS means all locally available obligations are proven, no local gap or finding remains. GAPS lists known missing behavior/evidence; BLOCKED explains why a reliable assessment is unavailable. Completion flags are computed by the host, not invented by the auditor. For delta review, inspect changed file hashes and consumers, close previous findings with new proof and return a complete current inventory. Request a fresh full audit if scope or independence no longer permits delta review.

class PlanningForecastIntegrationTest {
    private lateinit var factory: TestSqlDriverFactory
    private lateinit var database: LocalDatabase
    private lateinit var manager: ProductionScreenDataManager
    private var today = LocalDate(2026, 10, 1)
    private val zone = GrowZone(GrowZoneId("a"), "First shelf", GrowZoneType.GROW_LIGHT, 1)
    private val timeZone = TimeZone.UTC

    @BeforeTest fun setUp() {
        factory = TestSqlDriverFactory()
        database = LocalDatabase(factory, Dispatchers.Unconfined)
        manager = ProductionScreenDataManager(database, MultiplatformProductSettings(MapSettings()),
            now = { Instant.parse("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z") }, today = { today }, timeZone = { timeZone })
    }

    @AfterTest fun tearDown() { database.close(); factory.close() }

    @Test fun todayOrdersSimultaneousStagesInLifecycleOrderInsteadOfActionIdOrder() = runTest {
        val planned = batch(zone)
        val sow = planned.actions.single { it.stage == GrowStage.SOWN }
        val cover = planned.actions.single { it.stage == GrowStage.BLACKOUT_OR_WEIGHT }
        assertEquals(sow.due, cover.due)
        database.saveBatch(planned)
        val rows = manager.watch(ScreenId.TODAY).first().items
        assertEquals(sow.id.value, rows.first().task?.actionId)
        assertTrue(rows.indexOfFirst { it.task?.actionId == sow.id.value } <
            rows.indexOfFirst { it.task?.actionId == cover.id.value })
    }

    @Test fun continuousCandidateSurvivesRolloverAndAcceptedBatchSuppressesUntilTerminalOutcome() = runTest {
        database.saveZone(zone)
        val continuous = plan("continuous").copy(anchorDate = today, cadence = HarvestCadenceDays(5),
            cultureRotation = listOf(CultureId("radish"), CultureId("pea")), mode = HarvestPlanMode.CONTINUOUS_QUEUE)
        database.savePlan(continuous)
        val first = manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.single()
        assertEquals(LocalDate(2026, 10, 6), first.planEntry?.harvestDate)
        today = LocalDate(2026, 10, 2)
        assertEquals(first, manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.single())
        assertEquals(first, manager.watch(ScreenId.TODAY).first().items.single())
        val accepted = batch(zone).copy(actions = BatchPlanningEngine.plannedActions(BatchId("committed"),
            batch(zone).recipe.stages, today, mapOf(GrowStage.READY_FOR_HARVEST to LocalDate(2026, 10, 6)), timeZone.id))
        database.saveBatch(accepted)
        today = LocalDate(2026, 10, 3)
        assertTrue(manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.none { it.actionId == "confirm-suggestion" })
        assertTrue(manager.watch(ScreenId.TODAY).first().items.none { it.actionId == "confirm-suggestion" })
        assertTrue(manager.watch(ScreenId.BATCH_EDITOR, first.id).first().fields.isEmpty())
        database.saveBatch(accepted.copy(state = BatchState.FAILED,
            outcome = BatchOutcome.Failed(Instant.parse("2026-10-03T12:00:00Z"))))
        val next = manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.single()
        assertEquals("pea", next.planEntry?.cultureId)
        assertEquals(LocalDate(2026, 10, 11), next.planEntry?.harvestDate)
        today = LocalDate(2026, 10, 4)
        assertEquals(next, manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.single())
        assertEquals(1, database.snapshot().batches.size)
    }

    @Test fun legacyCalendarTargetRemainsCoveredAfterRolloverAndHarvestAdvancesFromActualDate() = runTest {
        database.saveZone(zone)
        database.savePlan(plan("continuous").copy(anchorDate = today, cadence = HarvestCadenceDays(5),
            mode = HarvestPlanMode.CONTINUOUS_QUEUE))
        val accepted = batch(zone).copy(actions = batch(zone).actions.map {
            if (it.stage == GrowStage.READY_FOR_HARVEST) it.copy(userFixed = true) else it
        })
        database.saveBatch(accepted)
        today = LocalDate(2026, 10, 28)
        assertTrue(manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.none { it.actionId == "confirm-suggestion" })
        database.saveBatch(accepted.copy(state = BatchState.HARVESTED,
            outcome = BatchOutcome.Harvested(Instant.parse("2026-10-28T12:00:00Z"))))
        assertEquals(LocalDate(2026, 11, 2), manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.single().planEntry?.harvestDate)
    }

    @Test fun zonesAndSavedPlanRowsUseSameIntervalsAndConflictDates() = runTest {
        database.saveZone(zone)
        val first = batch(zone)
        database.saveBatch(first)
        fun second(sow: LocalDate) = first.copy(id = BatchId("second"), plannedSowDate = sow,
            actions = BatchPlanningEngine.plannedActions(BatchId("second"), first.recipe.stages, sow, emptyMap(), timeZone.id))
        database.saveBatch(second(LocalDate(2026, 10, 26)))
        assertEquals(null, manager.watch(ScreenId.ZONES).first().items.single().occupancy?.futureConflict)
        assertTrue(manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.all { it.planEntry?.status == PlanEntryStatus.CONFIRMED })
        database.saveBatch(second(LocalDate(2026, 10, 12)))
        val zoneRow = manager.watch(ScreenId.ZONES).first().items.single().occupancy
        val conflict = manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.single { it.id == "second" }.planEntry
        assertEquals(0, zoneRow?.occupied)
        assertEquals(LocalDate(2026, 10, 12), zoneRow?.futureConflict?.date)
        assertEquals(PlanEntryStatus.NEEDS_RESOLUTION, conflict?.status)
        assertEquals(zoneRow?.futureConflict, conflict?.zone?.futureConflict)
    }

    @Test fun zonesIncludeProposalDemandAndDarkToLightCommittedDemand() = runTest {
        database.saveZone(zone)
        database.savePlan(plan("plan"))
        assertEquals(LocalDate(2026, 10, 12), manager.watch(ScreenId.ZONES).first().items.single().occupancy?.futureConflict?.date)
        database.savePlan(plan("plan").copy(paused = true))
        assertEquals(null, manager.watch(ScreenId.ZONES).first().items.single().occupancy?.futureConflict)
        val dark = zone.copy(id = GrowZoneId("dark"), type = GrowZoneType.DARK)
        database.saveZone(dark)
        database.saveZone(zone.copy(capacity = 0))
        database.saveBatch(batch(dark))
        val light = manager.watch(ScreenId.ZONES).first().items.single { it.id == zone.id.value }.occupancy
        assertEquals(LocalDate(2026, 10, 14), light?.futureConflict?.date)
        assertEquals(0, light?.occupied)
        assertEquals(PlanEntryStatus.NEEDS_RESOLUTION, manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.single().planEntry?.status)
    }

    @Test fun overlappingPlansShareCapacityAndEditorStatusWithoutWriting() = runTest {
        database.saveZone(zone)
        database.savePlan(plan("first"))
        database.savePlan(plan("second"))
        val before = database.snapshot()
        val rows = manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.filter { it.planEntry != null }
        assertEquals(1, rows.count { it.planEntry?.status == PlanEntryStatus.SUGGESTED })
        assertEquals(5, rows.count { it.planEntry?.status == PlanEntryStatus.NEEDS_RESOLUTION })
        rows.forEach { row ->
            val draft = manager.watch(ScreenId.BATCH_EDITOR, row.id).first()
            assertEquals(row.planEntry, draft.items.single { it.id == row.id }.planEntry)
        }
        assertEquals(before, database.snapshot())
        assertEquals(rows, manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items)
    }

    @Test fun savedPlannedZoneBlocksOverlapButDoesNotCountAsCurrentOccupancy() = runTest {
        database.saveZone(zone)
        database.saveTrayPreset(TraySizePreset(TraySizePresetId("tray"), "Tray", TrayShape.Rectangle(20.0, 10.0)))
        manager.execute(ScreenId.BATCH_EDITOR, ScreenCommand("save-batch", "saved", mapOf(
            "cultureId" to "radish", "trayId" to "tray", "zoneId" to zone.id.value,
            "substrate" to "Coir", "actualSeedMassGrams" to "10", "plannedSowDate" to "2026-10-10",
            "fixedHarvestDate" to "2026-10-24", "timeZoneId" to "UTC",
        ))).getOrThrow()
        database.savePlan(plan("plan"))
        val saved = database.snapshot().batches.single()
        assertEquals(Placement.Assigned(zone.id, zone.name), saved.placement)
        assertEquals(0, zone.occupancy(listOf(saved)).occupied)
        assertTrue(manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.filter { it.actionId == "confirm-suggestion" }
            .all { it.planEntry?.status == PlanEntryStatus.NEEDS_RESOLUTION })
        database.saveZone(zone.copy(id = GrowZoneId("b"), name = "Free shelf"))
        val first = manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.first { it.actionId == "confirm-suggestion" }
        assertEquals(PlanEntryStatus.SUGGESTED, first.planEntry?.status)
        assertEquals("b", first.planEntry?.zone?.zoneId)
        assertEquals("b", manager.watch(ScreenId.BATCH_EDITOR, first.id).first().fields.single { it.id.value == "zoneId" }.value)
    }

    @Test fun continuousTodayPlanAndEditorUseOneIdenticalForecastAndPauseReleasesDemand() = runTest {
        database.saveZone(zone)
        database.savePlan(plan("continuous").copy(mode = HarvestPlanMode.CONTINUOUS_QUEUE))
        val planRow = manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.single()
        val todayRow = manager.watch(ScreenId.TODAY).first().items.single()
        assertEquals(planRow, todayRow)
        assertEquals(planRow.planEntry, manager.watch(ScreenId.BATCH_EDITOR, planRow.id).first()
            .items.single { it.id == planRow.id }.planEntry)
        database.savePlan(plan("continuous").copy(mode = HarvestPlanMode.CONTINUOUS_QUEUE, paused = true))
        assertTrue(manager.watch(ScreenId.TODAY).first().items.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(manager.watch(ScreenId.PLAN).first().items.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun darkIntentReservesBothPhasesAndSoakingDoesNotOccupyNow() {
        val dark = zone.copy(id = GrowZoneId("dark"), type = GrowZoneType.DARK)
        val batch = batch(dark).copy(state = BatchState.SOAKING)
        val workspace = Workspace(listOf(zone, dark), emptyList(), emptyList(), listOf(batch), listOf(plan("plan")), emptyList())
        assertEquals(0, dark.occupancy(workspace.batches).occupied)
        assertTrue(workspace.planningForecast(today, timeZone).all { it.suggestion.status is SuggestionStatus.NeedsResolution })
        val free = workspace.copy(zones = workspace.zones + zone.copy(id = GrowZoneId("b")))
        assertIs<SuggestionStatus.Feasible>(free.planningForecast(today, timeZone).first().suggestion.status)
    }

    @Test fun actualOccupancyIsNotReleasedByEstimatedHarvestAndSeparatedProposalsFit() {
        val empty = Workspace(listOf(zone), emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(),
            listOf(plan("plan").copy(cadence = HarvestCadenceDays(20))), emptyList())
        assertTrue(empty.planningForecast(today, timeZone).all { it.suggestion.status is SuggestionStatus.Feasible })
        val active = empty.copy(batches = listOf(batch(zone).copy(state = BatchState.LIGHT_GROWTH)))
        assertTrue(active.planningForecast(today, timeZone).all { it.suggestion.status is SuggestionStatus.NeedsResolution })
    }

    private fun plan(id: String) = HarvestPlan(HarvestPlanId(id), LocalDate(2026, 10, 25), HarvestCadenceDays(1),
        listOf(CultureId("radish")), HarvestPlanMode.CADENCE)

    private fun batch(placement: GrowZone): GrowBatch {
        val culture = SproutPaceCatalog.cultures.first { it.id.value == "radish" }
        val stages = culture.stages.map { RecipeStage(it.stage, it.duration, it.instructionKey) }
        val id = BatchId("committed")
        val sow = LocalDate(2026, 10, 10)
        return GrowBatch(id, RecipeSnapshot(null, culture.id, null, stages, culture.seedDensity),
            TraySnapshot("Tray", TrayShape.Rectangle(20.0, 10.0)), "Coir", PositiveGrams(10.0), PositiveGrams(10.0),
            BatchState.PLANNED, Placement.Assigned(placement.id, placement.name), emptyList(),
            BatchPlanningEngine.plannedActions(id, stages, sow, emptyMap(), timeZone.id), plannedSowDate = sow)
    }
}
package com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.data

import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.catalog.SproutPaceCatalog

import kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNull

class ZoneForecastTest {
    private val today = LocalDate.parse("2026-10-10")
    private val zone = GrowZone(GrowZoneId("shelf"), "Shelf", GrowZoneType.NATURAL_LIGHT, 2)

    @Test fun plannedStartsAccumulateWithoutChangingActualOccupancy() {
        val batches = listOf(batch("active", BatchState.SOWN, "2026-10-09"),
            batch("first", BatchState.PLANNED, "2026-10-11"), batch("second", BatchState.PLANNED, "2026-10-12"))
        val forecast = forecast(batches)
        assertEquals(LocalDate.parse("2026-10-12"), forecast?.date)
        assertEquals(3, forecast?.projectedOccupied)
        assertEquals(1, zone.occupancy(batches).occupied)
        assertNull(forecast(batches.dropLast(1)))
    }

    @Test fun unassignedAndClosedBatchesDoNotInventFutureDemand() {
        val active = batch("active", BatchState.SOWN, "2026-10-09")
        val unassigned = batch("unassigned", BatchState.PLANNED, "2026-10-11").copy(placement = Placement.None)
        assertNull(forecast(listOf(active, unassigned)))
        assertNull(forecast(listOf(active.copy(state = BatchState.ABANDONED,
            outcome = BatchOutcome.Abandoned(kotlinx.datetime.Instant.parse("2026-10-10T10:00:00Z"))),
            batch("first", BatchState.PLANNED, "2026-10-11"),
            batch("second", BatchState.PLANNED, "2026-10-12"))))
    }

    private fun forecast(batches: List<GrowBatch>) = Workspace(listOf(zone), emptyList(), emptyList(), batches,
        emptyList(), emptyList()).workspaceForecast(today, kotlinx.datetime.TimeZone.UTC).zoneConflict(zone)

    private fun batch(id: String, state: BatchState, date: String): GrowBatch {
        val culture = SproutPaceCatalog.cultures.first()
        return GrowBatch(
            id = BatchId(id), recipe = RecipeSnapshot(null, culture.id, null,
                culture.stages.map { RecipeStage(it.stage, it.duration, it.instructionKey) }, culture.seedDensity),
            tray = TraySnapshot("Tray", TrayShape.Rectangle(20.0, 10.0)), substrateSnapshot = "Coir",
            recommendedSeedMass = PositiveGrams(10.0), actualSeedMass = PositiveGrams(10.0),
            state = state, placement = Placement.Assigned(zone.id, zone.name), events = emptyList(), actions = emptyList(),
            plannedSowDate = LocalDate.parse(date),
        )
    }
}
package com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain

import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.engine.ContinuousQueueEngine
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.engine.ContinuousQueueSlot
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.CultureId
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.HarvestCadenceDays
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.HarvestPlan
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.HarvestPlanId
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.HarvestPlanMode
import kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull

class ContinuousQueueTest {
    private val radish = CultureId("radish")
    private val pea = CultureId("pea")
    private val plan = HarvestPlan(HarvestPlanId("p"), date(1), HarvestCadenceDays(5),
        listOf(radish, pea), HarvestPlanMode.CONTINUOUS_QUEUE)
    private fun date(day: Int) = LocalDate(2026, 10, day)

    @Test fun initialTargetUsesPersistedStartAndLegacyAcceptedActiveSlotSuppressesNewCandidate() {
        val first = assertNotNull(ContinuousQueueEngine.next(plan, emptyList()))
        assertEquals(date(6), first.targetHarvestDate)
        assertEquals(first, ContinuousQueueEngine.next(plan, emptyList()))
        assertNull(ContinuousQueueEngine.next(plan, listOf(ContinuousQueueSlot(radish, date(15), null))))
        assertNull(ContinuousQueueEngine.next(plan.copy(paused = true), emptyList()))
    }

    @Test fun terminalSlotsAdvanceRotationUsingLaterOfFixedTargetAndActualOutcome() {
        val slots = listOf(ContinuousQueueSlot(radish, date(6), date(4)))
        val second = assertNotNull(ContinuousQueueEngine.next(plan, slots))
        assertEquals(date(11), second.targetHarvestDate)
        assertEquals(pea, second.cultureId)
        val third = assertNotNull(ContinuousQueueEngine.next(plan, slots + ContinuousQueueSlot(pea, date(11), date(14))))
        assertEquals(date(19), third.targetHarvestDate)
        assertEquals(radish, third.cultureId)
    }

    @Test fun unrelatedCultureAndOlderTargetsDoNotAdvanceAndActiveDuplicatePreventsAdvance() {
        val unrelated = listOf(ContinuousQueueSlot(CultureId("basil"), date(20), date(22)),
            ContinuousQueueSlot(radish, date(2), date(20)))
        assertEquals(date(6), assertNotNull(ContinuousQueueEngine.next(plan, unrelated)).targetHarvestDate)
        assertNull(ContinuousQueueEngine.next(plan, listOf(ContinuousQueueSlot(radish, date(6), date(7)),
            ContinuousQueueSlot(radish, date(6), null))))
    }
}

# FLOW-005 — Plan cadence and continuous queue

Linked requirements: REQ-005  
Linked screens: SCREEN-002, SCREEN-003, SCREEN-004, SCREEN-006, SCREEN-012

## Goal

Generate user-confirmed future suggestions that respect harvest cadence, culture rotation, and real place capacity.

## Entry and exit conditions

Enter from first setup, Today, or Plan. Exit with a saved/paused/deleted plan, a resolved conflict, or a confirmed suggestion that opens Batch editor.

## Ordered steps

1. Select cadence, culture rotation, and cadence/continuous mode.
2. Generate a forecast from versioned recipe ranges and capacity.
3. Mark impossible overlaps and offer resolutions.
4. Require confirmation before creating a planned batch.

## Branches and resume

Plans may pause without disturbing existing batch tasks. Deleting a plan removes suggestions only. Unresolved conflicts persist as `needs_resolution`.

## AC-050

Given the user opens SCREEN-006 with no HarvestPlan
When they save a positive harvest cadence, selected culture rotation, and mode
Then a new HarvestPlan is persisted and generates suggestions rather than automatic batches.

## AC-051

Given a HarvestPlan exists
When the application restarts and SCREEN-006 opens
Then its cadence, rotation, mode, paused state, suggestions, and conflicts are restored/recomputed deterministically.

## AC-052

Given a HarvestPlan has confirmed or active batches visible on SCREEN-003
When the user changes cadence, rotation, or mode on SCREEN-006
Then future suggestions update and confirmed/active batches do not change.

## AC-053

Given a HarvestPlan exists with related batches
When the user confirms plan deletion on SCREEN-006
Then suggestions and plan state are removed while SCREEN-003 batches remain.

## AC-054

Given a HarvestPlan exists
When the user pauses or resumes it on SCREEN-006
Then future suggestions stop or resume and actions for existing batches continue.

## AC-055

Given a proposed schedule would exceed a light/dark place capacity
When SCREEN-006 validates it
Then the conflict is labeled, the plan is not called feasible, and another date, zone, or capacity change through SCREEN-012 is offered.

## AC-056

Given a feasible or explicitly unresolved suggestion is visible on SCREEN-006
When the user chooses to accept it
Then SCREEN-004 opens for confirmation and no GrowBatch exists until the user saves it.

## AC-057

Given continuous-queue mode is active and a next batch is needed
When SCREEN-002 or SCREEN-006 evaluates current batches and capacity
Then one next-batch suggestion is shown without tracking household consumption or promising uninterrupted edible stock.

# SCREEN-010 — Close batch

Linked flows: FLOW-008  
Linked requirements: REQ-008

## Purpose and hierarchy

Record an explicit terminal outcome—harvested, failed, or abandoned—with date and optional outcome-specific details before freeing capacity.

## States

- Harvested: optional actual mass and note.
- Failed: optional reason and note.
- Abandoned: optional reason and note.
- Validation: invalid date or mass remains inline.
- Local save failure retains all fields; offline is fully available.

## Actions and iconography

Save outcome is primary; Cancel leaves the batch active. Outcome uses radio buttons or a connected group, never icon-only selection. Standard harvest, failed, abandoned, date, mass, and save icons supplement labels.

## Text layout expectations

Outcome consequences are plain complete sentences. Mass uses an explicit metric unit and accepts no implied forecast. At 200% choices and actions stack without clipping.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact may use a full-height form instead of a cramped dialog; expanded may use a basic modal with bounded width. Focus starts at the heading/outcome, validation is announced, and cancellation has predictable back behavior.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard harvest, failed, abandoned, date, mass, save, and close icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Each outcome light/dark; harvested with mass; RU 200%; invalid mass/date; long reason; save failure; compact full-screen and expanded modal.

# SCREEN-011 — Settings

Linked flows: FLOW-001, FLOW-009, FLOW-010, FLOW-011, FLOW-012  
Linked requirements: REQ-001, REQ-009, REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-012

## Purpose and hierarchy

Provide stable entry points for appearance, notifications, zones, tray presets, data portability, applicable advertising privacy, crash reporting, privacy policy, and destructive reset.

## States

- Content grouped by Growing setup, Preferences, Privacy, and Data.
- Crash reporting effective/failed initialization state.
- Advertising consent row appears only while fresh applicability requires management.
- Notification permission denied summary.
- Local loading/error only where a preference write is in progress; offline does not block settings.

## Actions and iconography

Navigation rows open SCREEN-012–016 and SCREEN-014. Theme uses a choice control; Crashlytics uses an independent switch with explanatory text. Delete all data is a destructive labeled action. Standard settings-category icons have text labels.

## Text layout expectations

Each row has a concise title and optional state summary. Crashlytics copy says disabling affects future collection, not already transmitted reports. At 200% trailing switches remain aligned without squeezing titles into unusable columns.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact is one grouped list; expanded uses list-detail for selected settings destination. Switch labels expose current state, rows have unique accessible names, and keyboard focus is visible. Scaffold/navigation own safe areas once.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard theme, notification, zone, tray, backup, privacy, crash-reporting, policy, chevron, and delete icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

EN compact light/dark; RU 200%; notification denied; consent-management row shown/hidden; Crashlytics off and init-failed; expanded list-detail; destructive reset confirmation.

# SCREEN-012 — Zones

Linked flows: FLOW-001, FLOW-003, FLOW-004, FLOW-005  
Linked requirements: REQ-001, REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005

## Purpose and hierarchy

Manage named Light and Dark growing zones with positive integer capacity and understandable occupied/available counts.

## States

- Content list with type, capacity, occupancy, and conflicts.
- Empty setup state with Add zone.
- Add/edit validation for blank name, duplicate identity handling, invalid capacity, and capacity below real occupancy.
- Delete blocked or explained when referenced; local save failure preserves input.
- Offline: fully available.

## Actions and iconography

Add zone is primary; rows expose Edit and Delete. Capacity conflict offers reassign, increase capacity, or keep affected future batches needing resolution. Use standard light, dark/covered, capacity, add, edit, delete, and warning icons.

## Text layout expectations

Zone type is always stated in text. Occupancy reads as localized `occupied of capacity`; names wrap. Numeric validation specifies positive whole places, not area or geometry.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact navigates list to editor; expanded uses list-detail. Counters have semantic descriptions, and warnings use icon plus text. Keyboard users can reach every row action without long press or swipe.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard light, covered/dark, capacity, add, edit, delete, and warning icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Light/dark zones with occupancy; empty; add/edit; invalid capacity; referenced delete; future conflict; RU 200%; expanded list-detail; offline.

# Domain

## Glossary

- **Grow zone**: a named physical area with a type and integer place capacity. Types are natural light, grow light, and dark.
- **Place**: the user's practical unit for one tray; SproutPace does not solve geometric packing.
- **Tray-size preset**: rectangular width/length or circular diameter in centimetres.
- **Built-in culture**: versioned app-owned catalog entry with stable ID and localized resource keys.
- **User grow recipe**: user-authored stages and guidance, clearly separated from built-in content.
- **Recipe snapshot**: immutable copy of the parameters used to create a batch.
- **Grow batch**: one planned or actual cultivation cycle.
- **Stage event**: a user-confirmed actual transition with timestamp and optional skip/correction context.
- **Scheduled action**: a derived next action for a batch; it is not a habit streak.
- **Harvest plan**: cadence, selected culture rotation, mode, and future suggestions.
- **Observation**: dated private text with an optional app-owned local photo.
- **Outcome**: harvested, failed, or abandoned terminal state.
- **Continuous queue**: a planner mode that suggests a next batch; it does not track consumption or stored harvest.

## Stable built-in identities

The first catalog version contains these language-neutral IDs:

| Stable ID | EN key | RU key meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radish` | `culture_radish_name` | редис |
| `broccoli` | `culture_broccoli_name` | брокколи |
| `arugula` | `culture_arugula_name` | руккола |
| `mustard` | `culture_mustard_name` | горчица |
| `pea` | `culture_pea_name` | горох |
| `sunflower` | `culture_sunflower_name` | подсолнечник |
| `basil` | `culture_basil_name` | базилик |
| `garden_cress` | `culture_garden_cress_name` | кресс-салат |

`garden_cress` means `Lepidium sativum`; do not label it Watercress or model `Nasturtium officinale` as the same culture.

## Grow-zone invariants

- Capacity is a non-negative integer.
- At least one light-capable place is required before the planner can call a plan feasible.
- A dark zone is optional. Covered or stacked germination on a light shelf continues to occupy that light place.
- Soaking occupies no grow place.
- A sown or growing batch occupies at most one configured place, or is explicitly `unassigned` with a visible warning.
- Moving between zones releases the prior place and claims the new place as one transaction.
- An actual stage event is never rejected solely because configured capacity is full; use another place, change capacity, or record `unassigned`.
- Historical batches preserve zone-name snapshots when a zone is renamed or deleted.

## Tray and seed recommendation invariants

- Rectangular area is width × length; circular area is π × diameter² ÷ 4.
- All persisted dimensions use metric units.
- Recommended seed mass is derived from area and the recipe's versioned density input, then displayed in grams.
- The recommendation is editable per batch and never represented as a guarantee.
- Supplier, cultivar, seed-lot text, and germination percentage are optional user data.

## Recipe invariants

- Built-in recipes are read-only, versioned, source-attributed, and resolved through resource keys.
- A built-in recipe may be duplicated into a user recipe.
- Personal recipes support create/read/update/delete/duplicate.
- Changing or deleting a recipe never mutates a batch's recipe snapshot.
- Built-in instructions use ranges for soaking, blackout/weight, transition-to-light, and harvest window when supported by sources.
- Food-safety guidance covers untreated/microgreen-intended seed, food-safe clean containers, drinking water, drainage, avoiding excessive moisture, and allergy awareness.
- Photographs and illustrations are not diagnostic references.

## Batch state machine

Planned batches may proceed through only applicable states:

`planned → soaking? → sown → blackout_or_weight? → light_growth → ready_for_harvest → harvested`

From any non-terminal state the user may close as `failed` or `abandoned`. A recipe may omit soaking or blackout/weight. A user may explicitly skip a configured stage; the event remains recorded.

Terminal outcomes are historical records, not deletion. Permanent deletion is a separate confirmed operation. Repeating creates a new planned batch with a new ID and snapshot; it never reopens or mutates the original.

## Scheduling rules

- Recommended dates are projections until the user confirms the real event.
- Confirming an early or late stage recalculates only dependent future actions from the actual transition.
- An explicitly user-fixed harvest date is never changed silently; conflicts are shown.
- Undo reverses only the most recent transition, restores the preceding state, and cancels/rebuilds affected future reminders idempotently.
- Short soak duration uses elapsed-time semantics. Calendar actions use local civil date/time and follow a changed time zone.
- Notification identifiers are stable by action ID so restart, restore, undo, and rescheduling cannot create duplicates.
- Android exact-alarm special access is not requested. Delivery near a soak target is best-effort and the authoritative due state remains visible in-app.

## Planner rules

- A harvest plan has a cadence, selected rotation, mode (`cadence` or `continuous_queue`), and paused state.
- Suggestions use recipe ranges and known place capacity; they are never batches until confirmed.
- A plan with unresolved overlap is labeled `needs_resolution`; the UI offers another date, another zone, or capacity change.
- Confirmed dates are not shifted silently.
- Editing, pausing, or deleting a plan changes future suggestions only. Confirmed and active batches persist.
- Continuous queue means another batch is approaching harvest; it does not guarantee edible stock at home.

## Observation and outcome rules

- Observations are ordered by actual timestamp and preserve user text verbatim.
- Photo files are private app-owned data selected through the system picker and linked by stable observation ID.
- Deleting an observation removes its linked file. Deleting a batch removes all linked observation files.
- Harvest outcome accepts optional actual mass, note, and result assessment. There is no predicted mass.
- Harvested, failed, and abandoned outcomes all release capacity and cancel future reminders.

## Error semantics

- Managers return Kotlin `Result` and preserve the original failure cause.
- Persistence/file failures do not partially report success.
- Restore validates into a staging boundary before replacement; any invalid archive leaves current data untouched.
- Capacity conflicts are domain results with resolution choices, not generic exceptions.
- Network, privacy endpoint, advertising, and Crashlytics failures never fail a core product operation.

# UX delivery evidence — 2026-10-10

Scope: [the implementation request](ui-ux-implementation-prompt-20261010.txt), UX-01–17, preserving the approved product, Forest & Lime, existing artwork and four primary destinations. The table maps implemented behavior to production code and behavioral tests; it is not an assertion that every acceptance surface has passed.

## Verification status

- **Locally evidenced:** [the preview review](ux-preview-review.json) records 231 production captures. Record8 had zero changed hashes against the reviewed set; unchanged pixels do not establish new behavior. [Android runtime evidence](../../build/reports/ux-android-smoke/runtime-results.md) documents bounded RU setup, suggestion, dirty-back, stage-preview and contextual dependency flows, including the APK/time boundaries and unverified cases.
- **Implementation:** the UX changes and post-audit fixes below are present. Focused tests and Detekt include runner session 60030. Authoritative executed checks, exact counts and matching-source receipts are recorded in [.vibe/receipts](../../.vibe/receipts/) and [the delivery results](../../build/reports/ux-delivery-results.md), which the owner updates after final verification. This source map makes no all-tests-pass claim and needs no tracked edit when those results arrive.
- **Release readiness:** not established by this document. The first independent audit returned **GAPS**; consult the delivery results for the later matrix and delta acceptance outcome, alongside the explicit content/native/runtime limits below.

## Data truth and the first growing cycle

| Request | Implemented scenario and production evidence | Behavioral evidence |
|---|---|---|
| UX-01 | Typed batch state drives Planned/Active/History, filtered counts and empty states in [RootUiAdapter](../../shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/RootUiAdapter.kt). Terminal identity carries outcome/date. | `RootUiAdapterTest`, `ProductionLifecycleFlowTest` |
| UX-02 | Today derives dated groups and stable task identity in [ProductionScreenSnapshotRenderer](../../shared/data/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/data/ProductionScreenSnapshotRenderer.kt); the hero is excluded from remaining rows. [EffectiveScheduledActions](../../shared/domain/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/domain/engine/EffectiveScheduledActions.kt) removes fulfilled stage tasks without rewriting manual decisions. | `ProductionScreenDataManagerIntegrationTest`, `EffectiveScheduledActionsTest`, `ReminderProductionIntegrationTest` |
| UX-03 | Setup readiness and contextual zone/tray routes retain the unsaved parent draft; skipped setup can resume from Today. [ScreenContent](../../shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/ScreenContent.kt) provides staged setup/forms. | `SetupReadinessIntegrationTest`, `ContextualSetupNavigationTest`, bounded Android RU smoke |
| UX-04 | Plan entries carry culture, sow/harvest dates, status and capacity. Accept opens the editor; Save creates a distinct batch. Covered fixed-harvest targets disappear and stale suggestion routes are unavailable in [WorkspaceProjections](../../shared/data/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/data/WorkspaceProjections.kt). | `SuggestionEditorIntegrationTest`, `DraftIdentityIntegrationTest`, `HarvestBackPlanningTest` |
| UX-05 | [Typed occupancy](../../shared/component/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/component/ScreenProjections.kt) separates current use from dated planned-start conflicts. Forecasts use assigned planned batches and do not assume a predicted harvest frees a place. Deleted zones explicitly unassign current batches. | `ZoneForecastTest`, AC-013 in `LocalDataAcceptanceTest` |
| UX-06 | [BatchDetailScreen](../../shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/BatchDetailScreen.kt) puts next action before dated history, observations and immutable recipe snapshot. Lifecycle actions distinguish planned edit from correction. Retained stage preview requires explicit confirmation and exposes fixed-date conflicts. | `BatchDetailProjectionTest`, `BatchActionFieldsTest`, `StagePreviewStoreTest`, manager confirm/undo/idempotency assertions |

## Recipes, forms and safe actions

| UX-07 | [RecipeScreen](../../shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/RecipeScreen.kt) separates built-in guide, personal editing and copying; shows typed durations/source/version data; retains sticky Save/Cancel. Existing batches use saved recipe snapshots. Numerical catalog substantiation remains open below. | `RecipeGuideIntegrationTest`, `RecipeEditorFieldsTest`, snapshot assertions |
| UX-08 | [TemporalFieldControl](../../shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/TemporalFieldControl.kt) and native formatting replace raw date/time input; stored timezone remains explicit but technical IDs are hidden from default editing. | `TemporalFieldControlTest`, `TimeZoneDisplayTest`, DST/back-planning tests |

Picker failures have typed errors; cancellation/failure preserves notes and prior photo. | `ScreenActionPresentationTest`, `RootUiAdapterTest`, `DraftStateTest`, `FileBackedRestartTest` |

Root dirty navigation protects app/system Back and sibling destinations; explicit discard is distinct from cancel. | `DirtyNavigationTest`, `RootUiAdapterTest`, Android edge-back smoke |

Invalid/cancel/progress/result states differ. | `SelectedBackupDocumentTest`, `BackupProductionProjectionTest`, `BackupPreviewRepeatTest`, backup integration tests |

Batch identity includes tray/date/zone; [OptionDisplayText](../../shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/OptionDisplayText.kt) localizes dates while retaining authored names. Decimal input accepts comma or dot and renders OS-locale separators. | `RootUiAdapterTest`, `SuggestionEditorIntegrationTest`, `DecimalPresentationTest` |

## Adaptive UI and visual proof

| Request | Implemented scenario and production evidence | Behavioral/evidence boundary |
|---|---|---|
| UX-13 | [App](../../shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/App.kt) retains four visible navigation labels at large text; privacy uses a short app-bar title and balanced choices. | RU/200% captures and `AccessibilityContractTest`; these do not prove spoken traversal. |
| UX-14 | [PrimaryListDetailScreen](../../shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/PrimaryListDetailScreen.kt) shows actual selected batch/recipe content; compact taps open detail. `SettingsListDetail` preserves the settings list beside active children; Plan supporting content shows capacity. Forms have bounded width. | Root/adapter navigation tests, production detail projections and expanded captures. |
| UX-17 | [ProductionScreenFixtures](../../shared/data/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/data/ProductionScreenFixtures.kt) feeds actual projections to scenario previews; real root confirmation and lifecycle tests supplement screenshots. | [231-image review](ux-preview-review.json), actual runtime report, `ProductionLifecycleFlowTest`; matrix/delta outcomes are recorded in the delivery results. |

Test sources are under `shared/domain/src/commonTest`, `shared/component/src/commonTest`, `shared/root/src/commonTest`, `shared/data/src/androidHostTest`, and `shared/compose/src/{commonTest,androidUnitTest}`. Test existence is implementation evidence; execution results belong to the final matching-source receipts.

## Independent audit and subsequent fixes

The [first independent audit](../../.vibe/audits/AUDIT-REQUEST-73591e2f-df2a-4935-b3a2-216472ef3854/audit.json) reported F01–F10, **GAPS**. Subsequent code addresses invocation-scoped command deduplication (F01), transactional zone unassignment and undo normalization (F02), reachable advertising eligibility and privacy cancellation (F03/F06), reminder delivery/environment/failure handling (F04/F05), persistent restore/reset recovery and cancellation-safe compensation (F05/F06), stronger production-path assertions (F08), and resource-injected EN/RU CSV headers (F10). Presence of these changes does not supersede the audit verdict without the final verification/delta review.

Recovery uses a persistent previous-workspace archive spanning photos, database and preferences, a startup gate, and retryable reminder reconciliation. Filesystem/SQLite tests close and reopen at modeled interruption windows; they are not OS process-kill or power-cut experiments. Native preference flushing precedes journal removal. CSV localizes headers while preserving authored row values and excluding photo bytes.

## Remaining limits and next evidence

The fresh full audit [6a3cda00](../../.vibe/audits/AUDIT-REQUEST-6a3cda00-3e14-4047-a53d-094f45ead16f/audit.json) returned GAPS against the 691-test snapshot. Its three high findings led to another bounded correction: Repeat now opens a retained prefilled draft and saves only on explicit Save; shared date-interval allocation accounts for committed and competing planned demand across light/dark zones; Today stage work navigates to lifecycle/outcome screens, while stale bare complete/skip commands are rejected. Production tests assert cancel-without-write, preserved historical snapshots, overlapping capacity and actual lifecycle events. Final executions and the subsequent audit must supersede the prior snapshot before these are accepted.

Current supporting evidence: [Lazyweb screen-family review](../../.lazyweb/design-improve/final-ux-20261010/report.html), [selected real references](https://www.lazyweb.com/agentic-search/8c09737d-977c-4729-aef6-6bfb28d06b7e), and [asset/derivative inspection](../assets/brand-refresh-review-current.json). The local review labels pending versus reviewed hashes explicitly; references do not constitute an automated Lazyweb acceptance verdict.

- [Catalog source review](../catalog-source-review-20261010.md): primary sources are relevant, but exact eight density/range derivations and `harvestDays` versus light-stage duration interpretation are not substantiated. Approved values were not changed.
- [Asset inventory](../assets/ASSET-INVENTORY.md): all 29 declared artifact/usage/evidence hashes and symbols were checked; this is not exhaustive runtime branch, accessibility or new visual proof. Final state-to-golden/post-golden design evidence remains part of F09.
- TalkBack was enabled in the bounded Android run, but traversal and audible order were not established. Full 200% runtime, every picker/photo flow, complete insets/focus behavior and the entire final-APK scenario matrix remain unverified where the runtime report says so.
- Windows does not establish `xcodebuild`, iOS Simulator/device behavior, VoiceOver or native delivery. Kotlin iOS compilation is a separate check. iOS daily summaries use a **30-day scheduling horizon**, replenished through lifecycle reconciliation; do not imply indefinite unattended delivery beyond that horizon. iOS advertising remains disabled.
- Final stable Gradle matrix and independent delta-audit outcomes belong to the delivery results and matching-source receipts. External publication, signing/service credentials and real-device SDK conditions remain separate release concerns. No global PASS or release-ready claim is made here.

## Planning delta after audit 29560ca5

The independent delta audit closed F01 (retained Repeat draft), F03 (Today lifecycle routing), F08 (bounded Lazyweb/current screenshot review), and F10 (current asset evidence). Its remaining F02 and new F11 led to one shared workspace forecast for Zones and saved Plan rows, and a continuous queue anchored to persisted plan dates and fixed batch targets. Active accepted slots suppress another suggestion across midnight; terminal outcomes advance rotation from the later of the fixed target and actual outcome date. Actual occupied places remain occupied until a real move or terminal outcome. Tests exercise interval conflicts, dark-to-light demand, rollover, accepted-slot suppression, and outcome advancement through production storage/projections.

Batches do not persist plan ownership: two overlapping plans with identical culture/target can share derived coverage. This bounded change preserves the existing schema and does not claim unique plan attribution. Final matching-source execution and independent delta review remain authoritative; F04 production-scenario coverage, F05 native runtime, F06 accessibility, and F07 catalog substantiation remain explicit evidence gaps. The close form now includes the selected batch identity before outcome fields; changed goldens require inspection and verification.

Fresh emulator smoke on 11 October exposed equal-time Today stages ordered by action ID (Cover before Sow). The production renderer now breaks due-time ties by lifecycle stage before stable ID; a storage/projection regression checks simultaneous Sow/Cover ordering. This correction does not alter the approved schedule dates.

# Catalog source review — 2026-10-10

Scope: the eight bundled cultures in [SproutPaceCatalog.kt](../shared/domain/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/domain/catalog/SproutPaceCatalog.kt), against [QG-011](../spec/quality.md#catalog-quality). This review does not change catalog values, version 1, its recorded 2026-09-20 content-review date, or the approved specification. It identifies evidence still needed; it is not a content-quality pass.

## Confirmed sources and limits

The catalog cites two primary sources: [Penn State's growing guide](https://extension.psu.edu/a-step-by-step-guide-for-growing-microgreens-at-home) and [The ABCs of Microgreens](https://extension.psu.edu/the-abcs-of-microgreens). Direct retrieval returned HTTP 403 during this review; official search-indexed content was available. These sources support general growing practices and explain that seed density depends on species, seed weight and germinability. The ABCs page points to a seed-density calculator and gives broad growth-cycle guidance.

This confirms the sources' relevance, not the exact eight numerical recommendations. No checked-in derivation identifies the source table/calculator version, input assumptions or unit conversion for each density and stage range. Every density currently points to the general growing guide. Do not represent an exact constant as independently substantiated by that attribution alone.

## Values awaiting numerical substantiation

| Culture ID | Density, g/cm² | Soaking, hours | Blackout, days | Value named `harvestDays` |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| radish | 0.028 | Not configured | 3–4 | 7–10 |
| broccoli | 0.022 | Not configured | 3–4 | 8–12 |
| arugula | 0.018 | Not configured | 3–4 | 8–12 |
| mustard | 0.020 | Not configured | 3–4 | 7–10 |
| pea | 0.085 | 8–12 | 3–5 | 10–14 |
| sunflower | 0.090 | 8–12 | 3–5 | 9–13 |
| basil | 0.014 | Not configured | 4–6 | 14–21 |
| garden_cress | 0.018 | Not configured | 2–3 | 7–10 |

The code places `harvestDays` in the LIGHT_GROWTH stage. [BatchPlanningEngine](../shared/domain/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/domain/engine/BatchPlanningEngine.kt) then accumulates that duration and blackout. Consequently radish spans 10–14 days after sowing and basil 18–27, excluding optional soaking. If the input means total sow-to-harvest time, blackout is counted twice; if it means time under light, the name and source evidence need to make that interpretation explicit. The present evidence does not resolve which interpretation was intended. Do not change timing merely from the variable name or a broad source range.

## Copy and evidence follow-up

[LocalizedText.kt](../shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/LocalizedText.kt) resolves culture-specific guidance keys to shared generic EN/RU guidance. Resource completeness therefore does not by itself establish crop-specific instruction fidelity. Existing safety copy includes clean tools/water, untreated seed, drainage, allergy awareness and non-diagnostic images; its applicability and paraphrasing still belong in the content review.

The smallest evidence repair is a per-culture source/derivation record covering density units, stage applicability, range interpretation and any app-authored adaptation. Retrieve and review the primary numeric evidence before claiming a fresh content-review date. If a recommendation is an app estimate, describe it as such rather than attributing its exact value to a general article. No external approval or invented growing trial is required by QG-011.

package com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.engine

import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.BatchSuggestion
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.CapacityDecision
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.CultureId
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.HarvestPlan
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.HarvestPlanMode
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.SuggestionStatus
import kotlinx.datetime.DatePeriod
import kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate
import kotlinx.datetime.plus

object PlannerEngine {
    fun suggestions(
        plan: HarvestPlan,
        count: Int,
        capacityAt: (LocalDate, CultureId) -> CapacityDecision,
    ): List<BatchSuggestion> {
        require(count >= 0)
        if (plan.paused) return emptyList()
        return List(count) { index ->
            val culture = plan.cultureRotation[index % plan.cultureRotation.size]
            val date = when (plan.mode) {
                HarvestPlanMode.CADENCE -> plan.anchorDate + DatePeriod(days = plan.cadence.value * index)
                HarvestPlanMode.CONTINUOUS_QUEUE -> plan.anchorDate + DatePeriod(days = plan.cadence.value * index)
            }
            val status = when (val decision = capacityAt(date, culture)) {
                CapacityDecision.Feasible -> SuggestionStatus.Feasible
                is CapacityDecision.NeedsResolution -> SuggestionStatus.NeedsResolution(decision.conflict)
            }
            BatchSuggestion("${plan.id.value}:$index", plan.id, culture, date, status)
        }
    }

    fun nextContinuousSuggestion(
        plan: HarvestPlan,
        actualHarvestDate: LocalDate,
        capacityAt: (LocalDate, CultureId) -> CapacityDecision,
    ): BatchSuggestion? {
        if (plan.paused || plan.mode != HarvestPlanMode.CONTINUOUS_QUEUE) return null
        val laterDate = maxOf(plan.anchorDate, actualHarvestDate)
        val targetDate = laterDate + DatePeriod(days = plan.cadence.value)
        val culture = plan.cultureRotation.first()
        val status = when (val decision = capacityAt(targetDate, culture)) {
            CapacityDecision.Feasible -> SuggestionStatus.Feasible
            is CapacityDecision.NeedsResolution -> SuggestionStatus.NeedsResolution(decision.conflict)
        }
        return BatchSuggestion(
            id = "${plan.id.value}:continuous:$targetDate",
            planId = plan.id,
            cultureId = culture,
            targetHarvestDate = targetDate,
            status = status,
        )
    }
}

"""Check native slot sizes, transparency, monochrome alpha and mask safety."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
res = ROOT / "androidApp/src/main/res"
for density, size, layer in [("mdpi",48,108),("hdpi",72,162),("xhdpi",96,216),
                              ("xxhdpi",144,324),("xxxhdpi",192,432)]:
    folder = res / f"mipmap-{density}"
    legacy = Image.open(folder / "ic_launcher.png")
    assert legacy.size == (size,size)
    assert legacy.getchannel("A").getextrema() == (0,255)
    bg, fg, mono = [Image.open(folder / f"ic_launcher_{name}.png").convert("RGBA")
                    for name in ("background","foreground","monochrome")]
    assert all(im.size == (layer,layer) for im in (bg,fg,mono))
    assert len(bg.getcolors(layer*layer)) == 1, "Background contains duplicate artwork"
    assert bg.getchannel("A").getextrema() == (255,255)
    assert fg.getchannel("A").getextrema() == (0,255)
    assert fg.getchannel("A").tobytes() == mono.getchannel("A").tobytes()
    assert mono.convert("RGB").getextrema() == ((0,0),(0,0),(0,0))
    # Circle stricter than the bounding box; excludes invisible antialias fringe.
    radius = layer * 33 / 108
    for y in range(layer):
        for x in range(layer):
            if fg.getpixel((x,y))[3] > 8:
                assert (x+.5-layer/2)**2 + (y+.5-layer/2)**2 <= radius**2, (density,x,y)
iconset = ROOT / "iosApp/iosApp/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset"
slots = json.loads((iconset / "Contents.json").read_text())["images"]
for slot in slots:
    size = round(float(slot["size"].split("x")[0])*float(slot["scale"][:-1]))
    im = Image.open(iconset / slot["filename"])
    assert im.size == (size,size), slot
    assert im.mode == "RGB", slot
print(f"PASS: 20 Android PNGs, 21 iOS slots, identical monochrome alpha, 66dp safe circle.")

SproutPace: ревью после записи эталонов

Проверка текущих семейств экранов относительно выбранных реальных референсов Lazyweb. Сохраняются утверждённые Forest & Lime, иллюстрации, функции и структура приложения. Это локальное ревью агента с референсами Lazyweb, а не автоматический вердикт сервиса или независимая функциональная приёмка.

Подборка Lazyweb · Идентификаторы и описания референсов · Точные хеши 32 основных снимков · Полная запись визуального просмотра

Просмотр завершён 10 октября 2026: все 32 основных снимка (16 экранов, light/dark) и 10 изменённых снимков record9. Остальные 221 эталон сохраняют ранее просмотренные хеши. Найденный повтор «Открыть партию» устранён; у главной карточки одно выделенное действие, открытие деталей — вторичное. Прогноз показывает выбранную зону. Итоговые хеши привязаны к полной записи просмотра. Это ограниченный визуальный результат, не глобальный PASS.

Что сопоставляется

ЭкраныРеальный референсКритерий и решение
002 Сегодня; 003 Лотки; 006 ПланAny.do: отдельные Today/Tomorrow/Upcoming/Someday.Разделять фактическое состояние партии, дату и состояние задачи. Не обозначать прогноз как факт. Карточка должна вести к соответствующей операции жизненного цикла; совпадение внешнего вида не доказывает её выполнение. Исправления аудитора F02/F03 проверяются отдельными production-тестами.
001 Первое открытие; 004 Партия; 009 Наблюдение; 010 Результат; 012 Зоны; 013 РазмерыUnited: прогресс формы и предупреждение о потере данных. PlugShare: явные Cancel/Save, выделение неверного поля.Сохранить шаги, видимые действия, конкретные ошибки рядом с полями и защиту несохранённых изменений. Повтор партии должен открыть заполненный черновик, а не создать запись до Save (F01). Не копировать маркетинговые флажки United или зависимость ошибок только от красного цвета.
007 Каталог; 008 Рецепт; 005 ДеталиCrouton: поиск перед карточками и компактные факты. Jullienne: источник, структурированные сведения, ясное основное действие.Встроенное руководство отделено от редактируемого личного рецепта; поиск доступен без открытия редактирования. Использовать утверждённые иллюстрации, не заменять их фотографиями из референса. Численные рекомендации каталога требуют отдельного подтверждения источниками (F07).
011 Настройки; 014 Копии и экспорт; 016 УведомленияFinch: отдельные backup/export/delete действия, удаление визуально отделено.Разделять сохранение, замену данных, экспорт и удаление. Предпросмотр копии показывает имя и состав, подтверждение — последствия. Настройки отражают системное разрешение и эффективное состояние функции. Эти состояния дополнительно проверены на Android.
015 Реклама; все диалоги и крупный текстUnited используется только как пример ясного выбора продолжить/выйти; сторонний consent-паттерн не принимается за норматив.Утверждённый контракт требует равнозначных Accept/Decline и короткого заголовка. Проверить переносы RU 200%, прокрутку и видимые подписи навигации. Снимок не подтверждает речь TalkBack, фокус или клавиатурное управление.
